title: Recreational Vehicle Service Technicians
description: Diagnose, inspect, adjust, repair, or overhaul recreational vehicles including travel trailers. May specialize in maintaining gas, electrical, hydraulic, plumbing, or chassis/towing systems as well as repairing generators, appliances, and interior components. Includes workers who perform customized van conversions.

tasks.text: Diagnose and repair furnace or air conditioning systems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — System checks partly aided by telemetry, still human-verified

dwas.name: Inspect systems to determine if they are operating properly.
Repair worn, damaged, or defective mechanical parts.

tasks.text: Connect electrical systems to outside power sources, and activate switches to test the operation of appliances or light fixtures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting electrical components is manual work

dwas.name: Connect electrical components or equipment.

tasks.text: Examine or test operation of parts or systems to ensure completeness of repairs.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Completed-work function check is physical

dwas.name: Inspect completed work to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Repair plumbing or propane gas lines, using caulking compounds and plastic or copper pipe.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pipe leak repair requires hands-on manipulation

dwas.name: Repair pipes to stop leaking.

tasks.text: Inspect recreational vehicles to diagnose problems and perform necessary adjustment, repair, or overhaul.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Overall vehicle condition inspection is physical

dwas.name: Inspect vehicles to determine overall condition.
Repair defective engines or engine components.

tasks.text: Locate and repair frayed wiring, broken connections, or incorrect wiring, using ohmmeters, soldering irons, tape, or hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on wiring repair in physical environment

dwas.name: Repair electrical circuits or wiring.

tasks.text: Confer with customers, read work orders, or examine vehicles needing repair to determine the nature and extent of damage.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Diagnosis from description aided, repair judgment human

dwas.name: Read work orders or descriptions of problems to determine repairs or modifications needed.
Inspect vehicles to determine overall condition.
Confer with customers or users to assess problems.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Repair leaks with caulking compound or replace pipes, using pipe wrenches.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Pipe leak repair requires hands-on manipulation

dwas.name: Repair pipes to stop leaking.

tasks.text: Inspect, repair, or replace brake systems.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Mechanical component inspection requires hands-on access

dwas.name: Inspect mechanical components of vehicles to identify problems.

tasks.text: Connect water hoses to inlet pipes of plumbing systems, and test operation of toilets or sinks.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Connecting hoses to piping is manual fitting

dwas.name: Connect hoses to equipment or piping.

tasks.text: List parts needed, estimate costs, and plan work procedures, using parts lists, technical manuals, or diagrams.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Record parts and repair details from provided data

dwas.name: Estimate costs for labor or materials.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Plan work procedures.
Record information about parts, materials or repair procedures.

tasks.text: Remove damaged exterior panels, and repair and replace structural frame members.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Removing equipment components requires manual dexterity

dwas.name: Remove parts or components from equipment.
Repair non-engine automotive or vehicle components.

tasks.text: Reset hardware, using chisels, mallets, and screwdrivers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Reassembly after repair requires hands-on fitting

dwas.name: Reassemble equipment after repair.

tasks.text: Open and close doors, windows, or drawers to test their operation, trimming edges to fit, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on mechanical testing in physical environment

dwas.name: Test mechanical equipment to ensure proper functioning.
Cut materials according to specifications or needs.

tasks.text: Explain proper operation of vehicle systems to customers.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — AI can script; live explanation and trust are human

dwas.name: Explain use of products or services.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Refinish wood surfaces on cabinets, doors, moldings, or floors, using power sanders, putty, spray equipment, brushes, paints, or varnishes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Refinishing surfaces is skilled manual labor

dwas.name: Refinish wood or metal surfaces.

tasks.text: Seal open sides of modular units to prepare them for shipment, using polyethylene sheets, nails, and hammers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Sealing gaps requires hands-on application

dwas.name: Seal gaps or cracks to prevent leakage or moisture intrusion.

emerging_tasks.task: Inspect and install lights, such as headlights and taillights.
